name: pulsar-edit-mcp-server
description: Pulsar Editor MCP server — exposes editor tools to LLM clients via the Model Context Protocol

mcpServerPort.title: MCP Server Port
mcpServerPort.description: Listen on this port for MCP requests from your LLM client

apiEndpointPrefix.title: OpenAI API Endpoint
apiEndpointPrefix.description: The OpenAI compatible API completions endpoint prefix of your LLM when using the built-in chat - everything before /v1/chat/completions. (Requires Restart)

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: The API key for authenticating requests when using the built-in chat

maxTokens.title: Max Tokens (built-in chat)
maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens the built-in chat LLM can return per response. Raise if responses get cut off.

focusEditedFile.title: Focus Edited File After Commit
focusEditedFile.description: When enabled, switches to the edited file's tab after each successful LLM edit. Disable to keep your current tab focused while edits happen in the background. Only affects files already open in a tab — closed files are always edited silently without opening a tab.

autoStart.title: Auto-Start MCP Server on Pulsar Launch

showChatPanel.title: Show Chat Panel on Startup
showChatPanel.description: Open the built-in chat panel when Pulsar launches. Disable to save screen space if you use an external client.

approvalAlert.title: Sound and Taskbar Flash for Destructive-Command Approval
approvalAlert.description: When run-command needs your approval for a destructive command, play a short chime (the system beep if audio is blocked) and flash the taskbar button if Pulsar is not the focused window. Disable to stay silent.

toolGroups.title: Tool Groups (disable unused groups to save tokens)

edit.title: Edit Tools
edit.description: replace, insert, delete, replace-all, sed, replace-function-body, apply-patch, write-file, read, get-structural-anchors, get-selection, insert-function-doc

navigation.title: Navigation Tools
navigation.description: open-file, goto-line, list-open-files, get-file-info, close-file, goto-focus

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics Tools
diagnostics.description: get-diagnostics (linter-bundle, live), get-compiler-diagnostics (gcc/clang/cl, requires save), check-struct (brace / comment / #if balance)

ghidra.title: Ghidra Tools (off by default)
ghidra.description: list-functions, search-functions, get-function-body, get-xrefs, add-comment, get-function-list-with-comments

kernelChecks.title: Kernel Style Checks (off by default)
kernelChecks.description: checkpatch, namingcheck, check-function-docs - Linux kernel C files only

debugging.title: Debug Log (off by default)
debugging.description: get-debug-log - the raw server log, only needed when the server itself misbehaves
